pr_away_ban_fans.d: The authorities ban your fans from the away match for public order reasons. You’re asked to comment.

o.r: The fans appreciate the solidarity.
An institutional answer.

pr_record_defeat.d: The press room feels heavy. How do you sum up the defeat?

o.r: The board appreciates the honesty. The players feel pilloried.
The team feels protected. The fans think you can’t see the problems.
The message lands: the team reacts.
o.rb: The players see it as punishment: morale collapses.

pr_youth_question.d: Journalists ask why the academy players get so few minutes.

o.r: The fans and the kids hope so. Now they expect it.
An honest answer, no promises.

pr_top_scorer_race.d: {player} is in the race for the golden boot. Journalists ask if the team will help him.

o.r: {player} is delighted. The old penalty taker less so.

o.l: “The team matters, not the scoring chart”
o.r: No new pecking order.

pr_coach_book.d: A publisher offers you a deal for a book about how you coach.

o.r: The book sells well: your name grows. A few nights spent writing.
The book can wait.

pr_final_day_nerves.d: Only a few matchdays left and the target is decided now. The press room is packed.

o.r: The team takes the field with fire inside, maybe too much.
The group stays clear-headed.

pr_praise_opponent.d: Before the game against {opponent} you’re asked what you think of them.

o.l: “A very strong team, to be respected”
o.r: Gracious words. The team may fear them a little more.

o.l: “We respect them, but we play to win”
o.r: The team senses confidence.

rv_spy_drone.d: During a closed session a drone flies over the pitch. Suspicion: someone is spying on your tactics.

o.r: Nobody sees anything: the tactics stay secret.
A heated row, a slightly edgy team.

rv_rival_target.d: The arch-rivals make a big offer for {player}.

o.r: {player} stays and signs. The fans adore you.
{player} joins the rivals. The city won’t forgive you.

rv_former_player_return.d: The next opponents, {opponent}, have a former club player who left amid controversy.

o.r: You neutralise him tactically.

o.l: Let the fans do the talking
o.r: A fiery reception: a tense atmosphere on the pitch.

rv_match_rumour.d: Rumours spread about a “fixed” match between two direct rivals in the race.

o.r: A clear, clean stance: respect in the game.
A cautious silence some read as indifference.

rv_derby_handshake.d: Before the derby the rival manager proposes a public gesture of peace between the two managers.

o.r: An appreciated gesture: a calmer atmosphere on the pitch.
The ultras like it, the tension remains.

rv_poaching_staff.d: A rival club offers double pay to your analyst and your fitness coach.

o.r: The staff stay together.

o.l: Whoever wants to go can go
o.r: Two key people leave the staff.

rv_rival_crisis.d: {opponent} come into the derby with their manager on the brink and a mutinous dressing room.

o.l: Go for them from the first minute
o.r: High pressure to sink a fragile opponent.
A cautious, organised approach.

pv_coach_family.d: Your daughter’s end-of-year play is on the same day as the final session before an important match.

o.l: Go to the play: my assistant runs the session
o.r: Your daughter is thrilled. Some at the club frown.
Work first, with a bitter taste.

pv_player_baby.d: {player}’s partner is about to give birth on the very day of the away trip.

o.r: {player} will never forget it.

o.l: He travels: the match is important
o.r: {player} plays with his mind elsewhere and a heavy heart.

pv_wedding.d: {player} is getting married and invites the whole team on a Saturday night, two days before a match.

o.r: A beautiful party: the group is closer.
A cautious choice, {player} understands.

pv_car_crash.d: {player} crashed his car while speeding. A few bruises and a big scare.

o.r: {player} recovers feeling supported.

o.l: A fine: he could have killed himself
o.r: A harsh message, but necessary.

pv_gambling.d: You discover {player} has run up gambling debts.

o.r: {player} faces the problem and is grateful.
{player} is sold: the risk is gone.

pv_tv_show.d: {player} has been invited as a regular guest on a Saturday night TV show.

o.l: He can, if he doesn’t miss training
o.r: Popularity soars, a bit less focus.
{player} gives it up reluctantly.

pv_tax_issue.d: {player} is under investigation for tax irregularities. Journalists ask whether he’ll keep playing.

o.l: “It’s a private matter, but clarity is needed”
o.r: A balanced stance.
{player} thanks you; some accuse you of being careless.

pv_coach_health.d: The doctor finds your blood pressure is high and advises two days of rest.

o.r: Your assistant runs training; you return sharper.
You keep working, gritting your teeth.

pv_charity_foundation.d: You’re invited to set up a foundation bringing football to deprived neighbourhoods.

o.r: A fine project that makes you known everywhere.
The project waits.

pv_player_mourning.d: {player} has lost a loved one. He’d like to go home for a week.

o.r: {player} returns when ready, and plays for the one who’s gone.
{player} returns, but his heart is elsewhere.

pv_nightlife_city.d: Rumours say {player} spends too much time in city-centre clubs. In training he looks tired.

o.r: {player} protests, but recovers energy.

o.l: I trust him: he’s an adult
o.r: {player} repays the trust.
o.rb: {player} overdoes it: legs and head suffer.

pv_house_move.d: {player} still lives in a hotel and can’t find a house. He asks the club for help.

o.l: The club office finds him a home
o.r: {player} settles in and feels at home.
{player} stays in the hotel.

pv_book_player.d: {player} publishes his autobiography. One chapter criticises a former club manager.

o.r: {player} appreciates it. The book sells.

o.l: Ask him to remove that chapter
o.r: The board is grateful, {player} less so.

pv_political_statement.d: {player} posted a message on a social issue that divides the country.

o.r: {player} thanks you; the board would have preferred silence.

o.l: Ask him to remove the post
o.r: Row defused, but {player} feels censored.

pv_luxury_car.d: {player}, on his first big contract, arrives at the training ground in a half-million car.

o.r: {player} gets the message.
No problem, but the fans mutter.

pv_coach_interview_life.d: A weekly magazine wants an interview about your private life and family.

o.r: The fans discover the man behind the manager.
No interview.

pv_teammate_girlfriend.d: A gossip magazine reports a relationship between {player} and a teammate’s ex-partner.

o.l: Keep the two apart in training
o.r: Tension contained, but the mood stays heavy.

o.l: Make them talk in front of me
o.r: They sort it out like men.
o.rb: The confrontation gets ugly.

pv_pet_training.d: A player asks to bring his dog to training: he says it relaxes everyone.

o.r: The dog becomes the mascot: a relaxed mood.

o.l: No animals at the training ground
o.r: Rule respected.

ss_ultimatum_speech.d: The board has given you an ultimatum. The players know. What do you tell the dressing room?

o.l: “Don’t play for me, play for yourselves”
o.r: The group responds as one.
o.rb: The speech sounds like surrender: the team is flat.

o.l: “First we stop conceding, then the rest”
o.r: A compact, focused team.

o.l: I don’t mention it: we just work
o.r: The board appreciates the composure, the group is tense.

ss_relegation_battle.d: The relegation zone is close. The board wants concrete proposals.

o.l: An experienced player for the run-in
o.r: A veteran used to these battles arrives.

o.l: A closed training camp until the end
o.r: An isolated, focused team.

o.l: Ask the city to fill the stadium
o.r: The stadium becomes a cauldron.
o.rb: The appeal falls on deaf ears.

ss_title_race.d: You’re in the title race. Every matchday is a final.

o.r: A fired-up team, a bit less energy.
Fresh legs for the finale.

ss_promotion_push.d: Promotion is within reach. The chairman is ready to invest right away.

o.l: A signing from a higher level
o.r: A player who makes the difference at this level arrives.

o.l: The group that got us here is enough
o.r: Faith in the group.

ss_season_opening.t: The first speech of the season
ss_season_opening.d: First day of pre-season: team, staff and board are listening.

o.r: The board likes it. The players feel the pressure straight away.

o.l: Talk about the group and enjoyment
o.r: The group starts relaxed. The board wanted more ambition.

o.l: Speak to the city: “Fill the stadium”
o.r: Enthusiasm in the city.

ss_halfway_review.d: Halfway through the season the board asks for an analysis. What do you ask for the second half?

o.r: The board appreciates the stability.

o.l: Some money to improve the squad
o.r: A slightly bigger budget, but the board now expects more.

ss_final_day_rotation.d: The target has been met early. The last matches can serve another purpose.

o.r: The kids get a taste of the first team.

o.l: Those who earned it all year play
o.r: The regulars are rewarded.

ss_losing_streak_retreat.d: The team has lost the last three. A jolt is needed.

o.l: Three days of retreat somewhere remote
o.r: Fresh air and clear heads.
The jolt works.
o.rb: Too much confusion: the crisis deepens.

ss_winning_streak_bonus.d: Four wins in a row. The players ask for a special bonus.

o.r: The team is even more motivated.

o.l: The real prize is the table
o.r: The club saves money.

ss_second_division_pitch.d: Small pitches, physical opponents: your football struggles at this level.

o.r: More pragmatism, less beauty.
Consistency, some difficulties.

ss_big_match_week.d: A lot is at stake against {opponent}. How do you plan the week?

o.r: A tactically ready team.
Legs at their best.

ss_season_end_trip.d: The end approaches: the players propose a team trip after the last match.

o.r: The group ends the season united.
No party.

ss_ultimatum_board_visit.d: During the ultimatum the chairman turns up at training and wants to address the team.

o.r: The chairman fires up the team in his own way; some are confused.

o.l: Ask him not to: I’ll speak
o.r: The group sees a manager who doesn’t hide.

ss_home_form.d: The team has stopped winning. Your assistant suggests a different approach for the next matches.

o.r: The team attacks more, taking some risks.
A tidier team.

ss_captain_armband_crisis.d: Even {player}, the captain, is playing badly. The fans want the armband taken from him.

o.l: Confirm him in front of everyone
o.r: {player} feels protected.

o.l: Ask him to prove he deserves it
o.r: {player} responds like a captain.
o.rb: {player} takes it as an accusation.

ss_derby_won_party.d: The city celebrates the win. The fans invite the team to the party in the square.

o.r: An unforgettable party, heavy legs the next day.
A short party.

ss_january_squad_review.d: The sporting director asks for a list of players to sell and positions to strengthen.

o.r: The director is impressed: the club gives you more leeway.

o.l: No cuts: I believe in this squad
o.r: The players all feel important.

ss_media_pressure_title.d: Every press conference question is about winning the league.

o.r: A focused, slightly tense team.
The group feels allowed to dream.

ss_injury_crisis_youth.d: Four players injured: the squad is very thin.

o.r: Two youngsters join the first team.

o.l: A free agent for the emergency
o.r: An experienced player arrives.

ss_rival_sacked.d: A rival manager has been sacked. Journalists ask for your comment.

o.l: Words of esteem for the colleague
o.r: A gesture appreciated across the game.
A cold answer that pleases the harder fans.

ss_coach_rest_decision.d: The staff suggest you delegate more: morning sessions to your assistant, you on strategy only.

o.r: The staff grow in responsibility.
Total control, more fatigue.

ss_attendance_record.d: The stadium set the season’s attendance record. The club wants to raise prices for the next match.

o.r: Record takings.
The fans appreciate it.

ss_title_celebration_early.d: The finish line is very close. The city is already preparing flags and the players are distracted.

o.r: Uncontainable joy, dropping concentration.
A team focused to the end.

ss_wage_cap_request.d: The club wants to introduce a salary cap for future renewals.

o.r: The club thanks you. Senior players nearing expiry are worried.

o.l: That way we’ll lose our best
o.r: The senior players appreciate your stand.

ss_rain_postponement.d: A cloudburst has flooded the training ground: three days without pitches.

o.r: Three days that recharge the batteries.

o.l: Train on an amateur club’s artificial pitch
o.r: Sessions on a hard surface.

ss_new_coach_rumour.d: The papers say the board has already contacted your replacement.

o.l: Tell the team and pull together
o.r: The group rallies around you.

o.l: Ask the board to deny it
o.r: The board publicly denies it.
o.rb: The board doesn’t deny it: the signal is clear.

ss_cup_rotation.d: The schedule is packed with league and cup games. What’s the priority?

o.l: League first: rotate in the cup
o.r: Fresh starters for the weekend.
The fans like it, the legs less so.

ss_ball_boy_trick.d: The kit man suggests instructing the ball boys to slow the game when you’re ahead.

o.r: Time gained, controversy in the papers.
No tricks.

ss_team_photo.d: The club organises the official team photo in the city centre with the fans.

o.r: A lovely day with the fans.
A quick shot.

ss_last_home_game.d: The season’s last home match: the club wants a lap of honour with the players’ families.

o.l: A lap of honour with everyone
o.r: A stadium in celebration.

o.l: Just a wave from the centre circle
o.r: A modest farewell.

ss_scouting_opponent_leak.d: A former {opponent} staff member offers you their complete tactical dossier.

o.r: You know every move, but if it gets out…
A gesture of loyalty that goes around the game.

ss_sponsor_bonus_goals.d: The sponsor offers a bonus for every goal scored in the next matches.

o.r: The team pushes more, taking risks at the back.

o.l: We don’t change our game for a sponsor
o.r: No bonus.

st_analyst_formation.d: The analyst presents data suggesting a different formation against high-pressing teams.

o.r: The data were right: the team breathes better.
o.rb: The team gets confused: better go back to the old shape.

o.r: No change.

st_set_piece_coach.d: A set-piece specialist offers his services: “Thirty per cent of goals come from dead balls”.

o.r: New routines for corners and free kicks.
No specialist.

st_press_fatigue.d: Pressing high all season is taking its toll: the team is tired in the closing minutes.

o.r: Energy recovered, fewer high turnovers.
Identity kept, fatigue rising.

st_opponent_scouting.d: {opponent} are a team with clear ideas. What does the week focus on?

o.r: The team knows the opponent’s moves by heart.
The team knows where to hurt them.
Fresh legs and a clear head.

st_new_tactic_idea.d: Last night you had a revolutionary tactical idea for the next match. Your assistant is sceptical.

o.r: A stroke of genius: the opponent can’t work it out.
o.rb: The idea doesn’t work: the team is lost.

o.r: No risk.

st_long_ball_pitch.d: The next away game is on a heavy, bumpy pitch: short passing risks getting bogged down.

o.r: A pragmatic adaptation.
Consistent, but the ball bounces badly.

st_defensive_errors.d: Lately the defence concedes too much. Your assistant suggests two routes.

o.l: A week of defensive work only
o.r: More solid, less dangerous up front.
Less space behind, more counter-attacks.

st_goal_drought.d: The team creates little and scores even less.

o.r: More chances, more risk at the back.
An extra weapon.

o.l: Stay calm: the goals will come
o.r: The group feels less pressure.

st_winter_style.d: The winter break is the right time to change something in the system.

o.r: New ideas absorbed calmly, some automatisms to rebuild.
The team refines its game.

st_wing_backs_tired.d: The wide players run miles every match: the staff report signs of fatigue.

o.r: Fresher wide men, a little less drive.
Maximum drive, rising fatigue.

st_captain_tactics.d: {player} suggests a small tactical tweak that, he says, the players would feel was theirs.

o.r: The group owns the tactics: more conviction.
{player} is a bit hurt.

st_video_mistakes.d: Your assistant has cut a video of every mistake from the last match.

o.r: Useful, if humiliating.

o.l: Only a video of the good things
o.r: Confidence rebuilt.

st_underdog_plan.d: On paper {opponent} are stronger. How do you prepare?

o.r: A compact team, conceding little.
Courage: you can win, you can also suffer.

st_favourite_plan.d: Against {opponent} you’re favourites. The risk is underestimating the game.

o.r: Control of the game.

o.l: A frantic pace to kill it early
o.r: A strong start, energy spent.

st_referee_style.d: The next referee is known for showing lots of cards.

o.l: Ask for clean tackles and no dissent
o.r: Fewer cards, a little less aggression.
No adjustment.

nt_break_fatigue.d: {player} returns from international duty after an intercontinental flight, two days before the match.

o.r: {player} rests: he’ll be fresh.
{player} plays with jet lag.

nt_coach_call.d: The national team coach phones you: he wants information about {player} for a possible call-up.

o.r: {player} gets called up and is over the moon.
No call-up.

nt_retire_national.d: {player} asks your advice: quit the national team to extend his club career?

o.r: {player} retires internationally and is fresher for matches.

o.l: As long as he can, play for his country
o.r: {player} carries on with pride.

nt_injured_on_duty.d: {player} got injured with the national team. The papers accuse the coach of overworking him.

o.r: The board appreciates you defending the club’s interests.

o.l: I only care about his recovery
o.r: {player} appreciates your support.

nt_tournament_summer.d: {player} will play at the big international tournament this summer. He asks you to manage his minutes late in the season.

o.l: Reduced minutes in the final rounds
o.r: {player} will be fresh for the tournament, a bit sad to play less.

o.l: He plays everything until the end
o.r: {player} happy, but tired.

nt_dual_nationality.d: {player} can choose between two national teams and asks your advice.

o.l: Help him choose with his heart
o.r: {player} thanks you for listening.

o.l: Choose the one that gives him minutes
o.r: Practical advice.

nt_break_friendly_club.d: Half the squad is away with national teams. How do you use the break with those left?

o.r: Those left learn the system better.
Fresh legs for the restart.

mk_deadline_day.d: The last hours of the window: the sporting director can close a deal for an experienced, ready-made player.

o.r: An experienced reinforcement arrives for this season.
The squad stays as it is.

mk_free_agent_veteran.d: With three injured, a veteran free agent’s agent offers his client, even just until the end of the season.

o.r: An experienced professional strengthens the squad.

o.l: We’ll make do with our own
o.r: No arrival.

mk_swap_offer.d: A club proposes a swap: {player}, who hardly plays, for one of their experienced players of similar level.

o.r: A refreshed squad: a ready player arrives.
{player} remains, still on the bench.

mk_release_clause.d: A very rich club is ready to pay {player}’s release clause. You have a few hours to decide.

o.r: {player} leaves, the coffers fill.

o.l: Raise the clause with a new contract
o.r: Expensive, but {player} is locked in.

mk_agent_complains.d: {player}’s agent calls: his client wants to play, otherwise he’ll ask to leave in January.

o.r: The agent calms down. Now the matches must come.
{player} goes to play elsewhere.
The agent threatens a fight.

mk_sell_to_balance.d: The accounts require a major sale by the end of the window. The club names {player}.

o.r: The books balance, the team loses a starter.
The club must find the money elsewhere, and isn’t happy.

mk_loan_recall.d: One of your players out on loan is doing well. With the injuries you could recall him.

o.r: One more player for the emergency.

o.l: He stays where he is to develop
o.r: No recall.

mk_scouting_report.d: The scouts have prepared a dossier on thirty undervalued players across Europe.

o.r: You now know the market better.
No deep dive.

mk_fan_favourite_sale.d: {player} plays little but is adored by the fans. An offer arrives.

o.l: Sell: we need money and space
o.r: A rational choice, angry fans.
{player} stays, and the fans are grateful.

mk_january_striker.d: The team can’t score. The sporting director can sign an experienced striker, but he’s expensive.

o.r: A centre-forward arrives, ready to score right away.
The strikers appreciate the trust.

mk_defender_needed.d: Too many goals conceded. An experienced defender is available on reasonable terms.

o.r: More experience at the heart of the defence.

o.l: We work with what we have
o.r: No signing.

mk_keeper_backup.d: An old goalkeeper at the end of his career offers himself as third keeper and dressing-room presence.

o.r: A quiet leader joins the dressing room.
No arrival.

yt_prodigy_report.d: The youth team coach tells you about a sixteen-year-old “like we haven’t seen in years”.

o.l: Bring him straight into the first team
o.r: The kid trains with the seniors and progresses fast.

o.l: He stays with his age group
o.r: He’ll develop without hurry.

yt_parent_pressure.d: {player}’s father is waiting for you outside the training ground: he demands his son starts.

o.r: The kid appreciates you shielding him from the pressure.

o.l: Promise him playing time for his son
o.r: The father leaves satisfied. Now the promise weighs.

yt_vulture_agent.d: A famous agent is persuading {player} to leave the club for a contract abroad.

o.l: A five-year deal with a raise
o.r: {player} signs: the club protects its talent.

o.l: I’ll talk to him: he’ll grow more here
o.r: {player} chooses to stay.
o.rb: {player} is persuaded and leaves for a fee.

yt_school_exams.d: {player} has to sit his school-leaving exams and asks for a few days to study.

o.r: {player} passes and thanks you.

o.l: Study at night, train by day
o.r: {player} trains, but he’s tired and stressed.

yt_youth_tournament.d: The youth team is invited to a prestigious international tournament. They’d like to take the kids training with the first team.

o.r: The kids gain international experience and return more confident.
The kids are disappointed.

yt_youth_coach_offer.d: A coach famous for launching dozens of talents is available for the academy.

o.r: The next academy graduates will be better.
The academy stays as it is.

yt_homegrown_captain.d: The fans dream of {player}, an academy product, wearing the armband.

o.r: A romantic choice: fans in raptures, seniors puzzled.
The dream can wait.

yt_talent_offer_scouts.d: A big foreign club wants to buy {player}, who hasn’t made his debut yet.

o.r: Money now for a kid who hasn’t played yet.
{player} stays and feels valued.

yt_youth_indiscipline.d: {player} has talent but very little discipline: lateness, half-hearted sessions, rude replies.

o.r: The kid understands and changes his attitude.
o.rb: The kid takes offence and stops developing.

o.l: A programme with the mental coach
o.r: {player} opens up and your relationship improves.

yt_youth_league_final.d: The youth team plays the final of the youth league. The kids ask you to be there.

o.l: Go to the stands with the whole first team
o.r: The kids play with heart: a special night.

o.l: I can’t, there’s a match to prepare
o.r: The kids understand, but they hoped.

yt_position_experiment.d: In the youth team {player} played wide with excellent results. The staff propose a position change.

o.r: A new role, new potential.
o.rb: The experiment fails.

o.r: No change.

yt_scholarship.d: A kid from the area around the stadium practises alone against a wall every evening. The scouts say he has something.

o.r: The kid joins the squad: the city loves the story.
The kid keeps kicking against the wall.

yt_injury_young_star.d: It’s {player}’s first serious injury. The kid is scared.

o.r: {player} feels protected: your bond grows.
{player} faces the recovery alone.

yt_social_youth.d: {player} has hundreds of thousands of followers and spends hours making videos.

o.l: Social media rules during work hours
o.r: {player} is less distracted.
{player} carries on, the fans follow him.

yt_youth_selection.d: {player} is called up by the youth national team for a ten-day tournament.

o.r: {player} returns with international experience.

o.l: Ask for him to stay with the club
o.r: {player} is disappointed.

yt_b_team.d: The club is considering entering a second team in a lower league to give youngsters games.

o.r: The youngsters will play real matches: faster development.
No B team.

yt_player_trial.d: An agent proposes a trial for an unknown seventeen-year-old from Africa.

o.r: The kid impresses everyone: he signs.
o.rb: The kid isn’t good enough.

o.r: No trial.

yt_academy_poached.d: A rival club is offering money to the families of the academy’s best fifteen-year-olds.

o.r: The kids stay.
Two talents leave.

yt_debut_nerves.d: {player} will make his first start. The night before he can’t sleep.

o.r: {player} takes the field calmly.

o.l: He has to learn to handle nerves
o.r: {player} takes the field tense.

yt_old_coach_advice.d: An old star of the same position offers to give {player} private lessons.

o.r: {player} learns secrets no training session teaches.
No lessons.

yt_scout_south_america.d: The scouts found a seventeen-year-old in South America: it takes a million and some luck.

o.r: A real talent arrives.
o.rb: Money spent on a kid who can’t adapt.

o.r: No signing.

yt_youth_bench.d: The academy director asks you to put two youth players on the bench.

o.r: The kids get a taste of the first team.

o.l: The bench goes to experienced players
o.r: Nothing new.

yt_growth_spurt_potential.d: The staff are impressed by {player}’s progress and want to give him more responsibility.

o.r: {player} responds: his ceiling rises.
Gradual growth.

yt_loan_return_star.d: In January a mid-table side asks for {player} on loan for six months as a starter.
